name: Harami Tama
source: The protagonist is an ordinary high school student until one day, he has a strange dream after which he is led into the youkai world to discover that he is Ou no Mitama who possesses soul of a king, and if he makes a child with one of the princesses of youkai tribe, that child will be a king of youkai.
translation: 主角是一名普通的高中生，直到有一天，他做了一个奇怪的梦，被带入妖怪世界，却发现自己是拥有王魂的王御玉，如果他和妖怪族的一位公主生下孩子，那个孩子就会成为妖怪之王。
